notes: Timeline: new Parse Content reformats entry text (sentence case, provider hoisted to a bold title, multi-sentence bullets, 1-2 lines centered / 3+ left) with an optional Copilot/Claude AI-reword pass; new Timeline Resize sets the entry font size and re-flows, offering to spread across more slides if it won't fit; new Title Manager color-codes each entry's date box by its bold title across the whole deck (cool-first palettes, random auto-assign, adaptive white/black text). Detection is far more robust: an edited Date Box now overrides a stale tag left by a duplicated entry, 'a.m.'/'p.m.' times parse correctly (no more entries snapping to midnight), multi-day timelines that carry clock times detect as Days instead of Hours, entry/leader/datebar recognition survives rename/ungroup/regroup/duplicate, unit detection is scoped to the bar's own slide, and rebuilding one timeline no longer deletes another timeline's continuation pages. Quick Graphics: added Remove Category, imported categories and graphics now survive updates (the picker is driven by the folders on disk), and the frame auto-scrolls to its content.
